pitch: Retrieve evidence while preserving a fragile diplomatic trust.
hook: A gardener asks the party to retrieve a dormant treaty seed before the abandoned embassy is sealed for the season. She needs the seed for a small teaching garden, not to claim that an old treaty has been restored. This is deliberately short fixture prose, not session-length evidence.
background: The Reed Delegation marked honest concessions with paired knots. The Orchard Delegation diverted the last shared cistern during a drought. Nothing supplied establishes whether a later reconciliation occurred.
opposition: A present-day volunteer, Tavi, waits in the Inner Hall. Tavi believes removal necessarily means theft, but has no authority to decide ownership. The gardener's written request changes Tavi's assessment of the party's purpose, not the unknown ownership. Tavi will document a removal or accompany the party rather than fight.
progression: Read both public cards, recover the key from the Annex and meet Tavi. The Annex sketch shows the mapped secret connection to the Repository; anyone comparing it with the wall seams finds it automatically. Bypassing Tavi is possible, but returning to explain afterward remains possible too.
ending: Taking the seed supplies the teaching garden while leaving ownership unresolved. Recording its condition and leaving it gives the gardener useful information but not the seed. Tavi's written witness note accurately describes what the party did; it never declares a new accord or canonical campaign outcome.

room_narratives.read_aloud: A card states: the Reed Delegation marked honest concessions with paired knots. A two-loop cord hangs beside it.
A second card states: the Orchard Delegation diverted the last shared cistern during a drought. Two loose teaching cards lie below: share water; keep all water.
sensory_details: Neither loose card has a cord.
The Inner Hall door has a keyhole.

room_narratives.read_aloud: A brass key rests under tangled teaching cords. A folded sketch lies beside them.
A volunteer sits beside a board reading: which offer could honestly carry paired knots?
sensory_details: There is space to pass the volunteer.
The board has two empty card holders.

room_narratives.read_aloud: A dormant seed rests in an open padded box. A blank condition label lies beneath it.
sensory_details: The seed has an intact dry shell.

entries.situation: The key lies under loose cords.
entries.discovery: Lift the cords; the key is automatically accessible.
entries.adjudication: The key opens the fixed gate without a check. Preserving the teaching cords is optional.

player_choices.action: Lift the cords and take the key
player_choices.outcome: Gain access to the Inner Hall.
Return later or find the mapped bypass using the sketch.

entries.situation: Several reusable teaching cords are tangled together. The separate sketch diagrams the mapped bypass.
entries.adjudication: Untangling takes ten minutes with no check; cutting takes moments but ruins one teaching cord. The sketch remains intact either way and exposes the secret route when compared with the wall seams.

player_choices.outcome: Finish immediately; tell Tavi one replacement cord is needed.

entries.name: An Honest Offer
entries.situation: Tavi's modern teaching board asks which Gallery card can honestly carry the paired knots. It is an exercise, not evidence of an additional historical concession.
entries.solution: Share water. Keeping all water offers no reciprocal concession.
entries.adjudication: Tavi explains the answer if asked and accepts an equivalent spoken offer. A wrong answer prompts the hint: what does the other side receive? There is no lock, penalty or required manipulation. Tavi separately asks why the party wants the seed; use the overview's reactions.

player_choices.action: Ask for the answer or decline
player_choices.outcome: Tavi explains or puts the exercise aside; movement remains possible.

entries.situation: The intact seed can be lifted from its open box.
entries.adjudication: No check is needed to take it or document its dry shell. Do not infer ownership or restoration of a treaty from either act.

player_choices.outcome: Supply the gardener; ownership remains unresolved.
Bring useful condition information, but no seed.
